slot_scores.name: minimum_profit_target
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked whether total weekly profit must be at least $10,000; the vague 'additional constraints' questions do not clearly target this hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: min_production_model_B
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Should the production quantities for Model A and Model B be treated as non-negative values, meaning zero production of either model is allowed as long as the other constraints are satisfied?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched the related issue of minimum production by asking whether zero production is allowed, but it did not ask specifically whether Model B must be at least 15 units per week.

slot_scores.name: exact_process_I_time
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 150-hour capacity for Process I a hard upper limit that cannot be exceeded, or can it also be extended through overtime?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the Process I 150-hour capacity, but only as an upper-limit/overtime question; it did not ask whether Process I time must equal exactly 150 hours.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No minimum weekly profit target, such as $10,000, exists.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never directly asked about a minimum profit requirement; it relied on a vague 'no additional constraints' answer and then listed no other constraints.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Process I time only needs to be at most 150 hours, not exactly 150 hours.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked only whether the 150-hour Process I capacity was a hard upper limit; it never confirmed whether exactly 150 hours had to be used.

stopping_behavior.rationale: There were no P0/P1 hidden slots to resolve, but before READY_TO_MODEL the agent repeated several already-answered questions about maximum limits, profit figures, and additional constraints, indicating over-questioning.

summary: The agent asked several relevant clarification questions but missed the hidden P2 minimum-profit slot and only partially probed the Model B minimum and exact Process I equality. It also repeated low-value questions before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
